nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Project Claude Code settings that allow read-only git and test commands, deny secret-file reads, docker and every git write, and add a prompt hook enforcing skill routing.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes that normalize text to LF, keep CSV spec data byte-for-byte (BOM and CRLF preserved), and mark images and fonts as binary.

nodes.summary: Empty marker that makes the backend `app` directory a Python package.

nodes.summary: Empty marker that makes the backend `app.jobs` directory a Python package.

nodes.summary: Empty marker that makes the backend `app.schemas` directory a Python package.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty marker that makes the backend test directory a Python package.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Guide to UI testing through the real interface, covering the isolated test stack, what each browser tool is for, commands, how to write test cases and personas, the unbuilt real-provider mode, and tool data-risk settings.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Standalone npm package for UI testing that pins `@playwright/test` and `agent-browser` and defines scripts for the test stack, tests, baseline updates, reports, and a visible Chrome for Testing browser.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Explains how a persona run pairs a customer voice (how the ticket is written) with an analyst (how the app is used), and sets rules for synthetic data, taxonomy limits, and never typing expected labels.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright configuration that runs tests serially against the isolated stack on port 5174, on desktop and Pixel 7 Chromium projects, with a 1% screenshot diff tolerance and traces kept on failure.
nodes.languageNotes: `workers: 1` is deliberate because every test shares one database, and `reuseExistingServer: false` guarantees a freshly reset stack per run.

nodes.name: reset_db.py
nodes.summary: Safety-guarded script that drops the UI-test MongoDB database so each stack start is clean, refusing any database name not ending in `_e2e`.

nodes.name: stack.sh
nodes.summary: Starts the isolated UI-test stack: resets `ticketlens_e2e`, launches the backend with mock providers on port 8001, waits for the database readiness check, then starts Vite on port 5174, and refuses real-provider mode.
nodes.languageNotes: The servers `exec` inside subshells and run without a reloader, so the EXIT trap's `kill` really stops them rather than leaving child processes behind.

nodes.name: TC-001-create-ticket.md
nodes.summary: Test case for creating a duplicate-charge ticket and finding it again by search, with expected labels, field-validation outcomes, and visual checkpoints for desktop and mobile.

nodes.name: TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: Copyable template for persona test cases, with sections for mode, personas, preconditions, ticket intent, expected labels, steps, expected results, and visual checkpoints.

nodes.name: smoke.spec.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end smoke test that creates a ticket through the form, finds it in the list and on its detail page, and checks pixel baselines with changing rows and totals masked.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Prettier ignore list that excludes build output, dependencies, the lockfile, and generated shadcn components so their updates diff cleanly.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for TypeScript and React that combines the recommended rule sets with Prettier, enforces a maximum complexity of 10, and relaxes the fast-refresh export rule for shadcn files.

nodes.name: sonner.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn wrapper around the Sonner toaster that follows the active theme, sets the status icons, and maps toast colors and radius to the app's design tokens.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the settings feature directory in git.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind and shadcn styles, defines the light and dark theme tokens, maps them into the Tailwind theme, and sets base element styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 is configured in CSS: `@theme inline` exposes the `:root` and `.dark` custom properties as utilities, and `@custom-variant dark` ties dark mode to the `.dark` class.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: React entry point that mounts the app under StrictMode with the theme provider (light by default, remembered per browser), TanStack Query client, router, and global toaster.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the frontend services directory in git.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the frontend types directory in git.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite configuration with the React and Tailwind plugins, the `@` alias for `src`, and a dev server fixed to localhost:5173 because the backend allows exactly that CORS origin.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.summary: Renders the Sonner toaster with the current theme, custom status icons, and design-token colors, passing other props through.
